# DSH Agent Studio
Build and test Agents visually in DeepSeek Harness Web: bind tools by plugin, edit tool results duri
ng trials, preserve session capability snapshots, and export standalone presets. A guided Agent Crea
tor preset helps draft new Agents in conversation.

**Version scope:** Studio **1.13.3**, portable runtime **1.10.5**. Only the two exact DSH versions a

## Configure, try, revise

1. Open **Agent Studio** in the sidebar. Create an Agent or copy a built-in preset.
2. Choose a chat
model, instructions, plugin tools and Skills. Choose all current tools from a plugin or an explicit

subset.
3. Trial-run a message. Run tools manually or automatically, edit their results, then conti

nue or rerun. Previous runs remain available in history.
4. Start a normal conversation with the sav
ed Agent, or export its preset for another installation.
Tool ownership follows the actual host registrations. At session start, Studio stores the effective
tool set and plugin identities. Existing sessions and historical retries keep their recorded scope;
plugin removal or changed ownership is reported rather than silently granting a replacement tool.
Screenshots use an isolated DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 instance, synthetic data and a local scripted model. They
illustrate the interface, not the quality of an external model's answers.
## Guided Agent Creator
Choose **Agent 创建助手 / Agent Creator** before starting a conversation. It collects requirements, sele
cts available capabilities, drafts instructions, checks the draft, offers a trial, and saves only af
ter confirmation. Creator tools are scoped to this preset; they are not added to standard mode or un
related Agents. Creator trials execute read-only tools and record other calls without executing them
. Unsaved drafts do not appear in the Studio Agent list.
## What this plugin changes
Studio **disables the official `tools` configuration row** and installs a `ToolRuntime` subclass tha
t records plugin ownership. Tool execution, schema validation, permissions and scope enforcement rem
ain in the official superclass. The original row's configuration is inherited. It also mounts a capa
bility snapshot service and registers saved Agents as presets.
**Other plugins that replace the tool provider or rewrite the same tool layer can conflict.** Check
the combined configuration before using them together. Restart the profile after installation, remov
al or tool-provider configuration changes. Removing the Studio bundle restores the official provider
unless another user patch disables it.
## Data and removal

| Domain | Stored data |

|
| `workbench_agent_studio_capabilities` | Session capability snapshots |
| `workbench_agent_studi
o_library_migrations` | Explicit compatibility-migration receipts; Library is optional |
The default working directory is `$DSH_HOME/workbench-agent-studio/workspace`. Models, credentials a
nd tool providers come from your host. Trial content is sent to the model you select; selected tools
act with their host permissions.
